newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker firm despite few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker firm despite few enquiries.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market firmed on Thursday in reaction to stronger cargo prics despite shipowners putting off their purchases in the face of rising prices, traders said.

The market was fundamentally bearish as the weekly fuel oil residue stocks stood at a high 12.188 million barrels for the week ending June 25, but levels were high due to firm cargo market which was supported by demand from one local trader.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at around $100 per tonne. MDO and gas oil were at $170 and $180 respectively.
